name: How to Plan for Your Perfect Kitchen Island Installation

step.name: Step 1: Define its Purpose
step.text: Before anything else, figure out what you want your island to do. Will it be a prep station, a dining spot, extra storage, or perhaps house an appliance like a sink or stovetop? Knowing its primary role helps determine the size, features, and necessary utilities. If you want seating, you'll need an overhang. If it's a cooking zone, you'll need power and possibly ventilation.

step.name: Step 2: Measure Your Space & Plan for Flow
step.text: This is crucial! You need enough clearance around the island – ideally 36-48 inches – for comfortable movement and appliance access.
